definitionZh: -moz-box-flex和 -webkit-box-flex CSS 属性指定一个-moz-box或 -webkit-box是怎样生长来填充包含它的盒子的,在装箱的布局方向上.
sourceDefinition: The -moz-box-flex and -webkit-box-flex CSS properties specify how a -moz-box or -webkit-box grows to fill the box that contains it, in the direction of the containing box's layout.
